#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Providers;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Navigation\NavigationResolver;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\ServiceProvider;
use Platform\UiNavigation\BreadcrumbBuilder;
use Platform\UiNavigation\Contracts\AdminResolverInterface;

class PlatformNavigationServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        $this->app->bind(AdminResolverInterface::class, fn() => new class implements AdminResolverInterface {
            public function isAdmin(\Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable $user): bool
            {
                return $user instanceof User && $user->isSystemAdmin();
            }
        });

    }

    public function boot(): void
    {
        // Share breadcrumbs with every view so in-container placements work
        // (Livewire full-page components render the content view before the
        // layout, so a layout-only composer fires too late).
        // once() ensures BreadcrumbBuilder->build() runs at most once per request.
        view()->composer('*', function ($view): void {
            $user = Auth::user();

            if (!$user instanceof User) {
                return;
            }

            if (array_key_exists('breadcrumbs', $view->getData())) {
                return;
            }

            $breadcrumbs = once(fn () => $this->app->make(BreadcrumbBuilder::class)->build($user, $user->isSystemAdmin()));
            $view->with('breadcrumbs', $breadcrumbs);
        });

        view()->composer(['layouts.authenticated'], function ($view): void {
            $user = Auth::user();

            if (!$user instanceof User) {
                return;
            }

            $resolver = $this->app->make(NavigationResolver::class);
            $allItems = $resolver->resolve($user);

            $placedBuckets = ['user-menu', 'workspace-sidebar', 'account-sidebar'];
            $buckets = ['main' => [], 'user-menu' => [], 'workspace-sidebar' => [], 'account-sidebar' => []];
            foreach ($allItems as $item) {
                $placement = $item['placement'] ?? null;
                $bucket = \in_array($placement, $placedBuckets, true) ? $placement : 'main';
                $buckets[$bucket][] = $item;
            }

            if (request()->routeIs('admin.*')) {
                $buckets['main'] = array_values(array_filter(
                    $buckets['main'],
                    static fn (array $item): bool => str_starts_with((string) ($item['key'] ?? ''), 'super-admin-'),
                ));

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Traits\PermissionTesting;
use Tests\Traits\TeamTesting;

/**
 * Base class for feature tests
 * 
 * Feature tests validate HTTP requests, routes, and full application workflows.
 * They test the application from the outside-in, simulating real user interactions.
 */
abstract class FeatureTestCase extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;
    use PermissionTesting;
    use TeamTesting;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // RefreshDatabase wipes the permissions table every test, so we reseed
        // when it's empty. The old `$permissionsSeeded` static was dead code
        // (set but never read) and misleadingly suggested per-class caching
        // that couldn't work under RefreshDatabase. Removed 2026-04-23 per
        // test-review-1-3 isolation finding.
        $this->seedPermissionsOnce();
    }
    
    /**
     * Seed permissions only once per test run to avoid redundant seeding
     */
    protected function seedPermissionsOnce(): void
    {
        // Check if permissions table is empty (RefreshDatabase clears it)
        if (\App\Models\RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shortcut: create an email-verified user. Targets the 25+ repetitions
     * of `User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()])` across
     * Epic 1 suites (test-review-1-3 Maintainability finding).
     */
    protected function verifiedUser(array $attributes = []): \App\Models\User
    {
        return \App\Models\User::factory()->create(array_merge(
            ['email_verified_at' => now()],
            $attributes,
        ));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\UiNavigation;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;

/**
 * Resolves active state for navigation items based on the current request route.
 *
 * Stateless — instantiate with a Request or resolve from the container.
 */
class ActiveStateResolver
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly Request $request,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Check if a route is currently active.
     * Matches the exact route or any route under its prefix (e.g. show, edit, create).
     */
    public function isRouteActive(string $route, bool $exact = false): bool
    {
        $currentRoute = $this->request->route()?->getName();

        if (! $currentRoute) {
            return false;
        }

        $isExactMatch = $currentRoute === $route;

        if ($exact || $isExactMatch) {
            return $isExactMatch;
        }

        // Derive the route prefix by stripping the terminal action segment
        // e.g. "admin.tickets.index" → "admin.tickets"
        // Any route under that prefix (show, edit, create, …) is considered active.
        $prefix = preg_replace('/\.(index|show|create|edit|store|update|destroy)$/', '', $route);

        return str_starts_with($currentRoute, "{$prefix}.");
    }

    /**
     * Update active states in a cached menu structure.
     *
     * Menu items must carry a `_key` field (set during build) so
     * we can recalculate without re-reading config.
     *
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $menu
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function updateActiveStates(array $menu): array
    {
        foreach ($menu as $index => $item) {
            if (($item['type'] ?? null) === 'section' && isset($item['items'])) {
                $sectionActive = false;

                foreach ($item['items'] as $childIndex => $child) {
                    if (isset($child['route'])) {
                        $active = $this->isRouteActive($child['route'], (bool) ($child['active_exact'] ?? false));
                        $menu[$index]['items'][$childIndex]['active'] = $active;
                        if ($active) {
                            $sectionActive = true;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $menu[$index]['active'] = $sectionActive;
            } elseif (isset($item['route'])) {
                $menu[$index]['active'] = $this->isRouteActive($item['route'], (bool) ($item['active_exact'] ?? false));
            }
        }

        return $menu;
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature\Navigation;

use App\Enums\PlanTier;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\View;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\Billing\Support\BillingTestFixtures;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T3 — mobile primary navigation active state and scroll restoration
 * contract.
 *
 * Asserts the server-rendered contract only (markers + keys a client would
 * consume); no JavaScript behaviour is exercised here.
 */
class MobileNavScrollStateTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use BillingTestFixtures;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        Cache::flush();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function current_primary_nav_item_is_programmatically_marked_in_both_variants(): void
    {
        [$admin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);

        $html = $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('user.dashboard'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->getContent();

        $desktop = $this->primaryNavLinks($html, mobile: false);
        $mobile = $this->primaryNavLinks($html, mobile: true);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($desktop, 'desktop primary navigation rendered no links');

        // AC3 — both variants render, with distinct but paired test ids.
        $this->assertSame(
            array_map(static fn (string $id): string => $id . '-mobile', array_keys($desktop)),
            array_keys($mobile),
            'mobile variant must stay separately addressable from desktop',
        );

        // AC1 + AC2 — current-ness is programmatic and singular per variant.
        $currentDesktop = $this->currentLinks($desktop);
        $currentMobile = $this->currentLinks($mobile);

        $this->assertCount(1, $currentDesktop, 'exactly one desktop item must be marked current');
        $this->assertCount(1, $currentMobile, 'exactly one mobile item must be marked current');

        $desktopTestid = array_key_first($currentDesktop);

        $this->assertSame(
            $desktopTestid . '-mobile',
            array_key_first($currentMobile),
            'desktop and mobile must mark the same item current',
        );

        // AC6 — the current item is the page actually requested, href unchanged.
        $this->assertSame(route('user.dashboard'), $currentDesktop[$desktopTestid]['href'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(route('user.dashboard'), $currentMobile[$desktopTestid . '-mobile']['href'] ?? null);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function primary_nav_links_expose_stable_shared_scroll_restoration_keys_and_a_page_region(): void
    {
        [$admin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);

        $first = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('user.dashboard'))->assertOk()->getContent();
        $second = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('user.dashboard'))->assertOk()->getContent();

        $desktop = $this->primaryNavLinks($first, mobile: false);
        $mobile = $this->primaryNavLinks($first, mobile: true);
        $desktopAgain = $this->primaryNavLinks($second, mobile: false);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($desktop, 'desktop primary navigation rendered no links');

        $keys = [];

        foreach ($desktop as $testid => $attributes) {
            $key = $attributes[self::SCROLL_KEY_ATTRIBUTE] ?? null;

            $this->assertIsString($key, "{$testid} is missing a scroll-restoration key");
            $this->assertNotSame('', $key, "{$testid} has an empty scroll-restoration key");

            // AC4 — identical across variants…
            $this->assertSame(
                $key,
                $mobile[$testid . '-mobile'][self::SCROLL_KEY_ATTRIBUTE] ?? null,
                "{$testid} scroll-restoration key differs between desktop and mobile",
            );

            // …and stable across requests.
            $this->assertSame(
                $key,
                $desktopAgain[$testid][self::SCROLL_KEY_ATTRIBUTE] ?? null,
                "{$testid} scroll-restoration key is not stable across requests",
            );

            $keys[] = $key;
        }

        $this->assertSameSize($keys, array_unique($keys), 'scroll-restoration keys must identify distinct items');

        // AC5 — the layout marks the region for the page being rendered, using
        // the same key space as the links so Back/Forward can match them up.
        $this->assertSame(
            1,
            preg_match('/data-scroll-restore-region="([^"]+)"/', $first, $region),
            'authenticated layout must emit a scroll-restoration region marker',
        );

        $currentDesktop = $this->currentLinks($desktop);
        $currentKey = reset($currentDesktop)[self::SCROLL_KEY_ATTRIBUTE] ?? null;

        $this->assertSame(
            $currentKey,
            $region[1],
            'region marker must identify the page currently rendered',
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function mobile_variant_preserves_exclusion_filtering_badges_and_existing_output(): void
    {
        $html = View::make('components.topbar-navigation', [
            'variant' => 'mobile',
            'except' => ['tenant-events'],
            'items' => [
                [
                    'key' => 'tenant-dashboard',
                    'label' => 'Dashboard',
                    'route' => 'user.dashboard',
                    'data_testid' => 'nav-dashboard',
                    'active' => true,
                    'badge' => 7,
                ],
                [
                    'key' => 'tenant-events',
                    'label' => 'Events',
                    'route' => 'events.index',
                    'data_testid' => 'nav-events',
                    'active' => false,
                ],
                [
                    'key' => 'tenant-routeless',
                    'label' => 'Routeless',
                    'route' => null,
                ],
            ],
        ])->render();

        $links = $this->primaryNavLinks($html, mobile: true);

        // AC6 — exclusion list and route-less items still drop out; test id and
        // href output is unchanged.
        $this->assertSame(['nav-dashboard-mobile'], array_keys($links));
        $this->assertSame(route('user.dashboard'), $links['nav-dashboard-mobile']['href'] ?? null);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('nav-events', $html);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('nav-tenant-routeless', $html);

        // AC6 — badge still renders alongside the new contract attributes.
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/<span[^>]*>\s*7\s*<\/span>/', $html);

        // AC1/AC4 — the mobile-only rendering still carries both markers.
        $this->assertSame('page', $links['nav-dashboard-mobile']['aria-current'] ?? null);
        $this->assertNotSame('', $links['nav-dashboard-mobile'][self::SCROLL_KEY_ATTRIBUTE] ?? '');
    }

    private const SCROLL_KEY_ATTRIBUTE = 'data-scroll-restore-key';

    /**
     * Primary-navigation anchors from rendered HTML, keyed by test id.
     *
     * @return array<string, array<string, string>>
     */
    private function primaryNavLinks(string $html, bool $mobile): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/<a\b[^>]*>/i', $html, $tags);

        $links = [];

        foreach ($tags[0] as $tag) {
            preg_match_all('/([a-zA-Z0-9_:.\-]+)="([^"]*)"/', $tag, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER);

            $attributes = [];

            foreach ($matches as $match) {
                $attributes[$match[1]] = $match[2];
            }

            $testid = $attributes['data-testid'] ?? '';

            if (! str_starts_with($testid, 'nav-')) {
                continue;
            }

            if (str_ends_with($testid, '-mobile') !== $mobile) {
                continue;
            }

            $links[$testid] = $attributes;
        }

        return $links;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, array<string, string>>  $links
     * @return array<string, array<string, string>>
     */
    private function currentLinks(array $links): array
    {
        return array_filter(
            $links,
            static fn (array $attributes): bool => ($attributes['aria-current'] ?? null) === 'page',
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Navigation;

/**
 * Derives the scroll-restoration keys the front end uses to store and restore
 * a page's scroll offset across Back/Forward navigation.
 *
 * The key is derived from the navigation item itself (not from the rendering
 * variant or the request), so the desktop and mobile renderings of the same
 * item emit the same key and the key is stable across requests.
 */
final class ScrollRestorationKey
{
    /**
     * Scroll-restoration key for a single navigation item.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $item
     */
    public static function forItem(array $item): string
    {
        $raw = (string) ($item['key'] ?? '');

        if ($raw === '') {
            $raw = (string) ($item['route'] ?? '');
        }

        return self::normalize($raw);
    }

    /**
     * Index of the single item that is current for this request, honouring the
     * same filtering the renderer applies. Returns null when nothing is current.
     *
     * @param  array<array-key, array<string, mixed>>  $items
     * @param  array<int, string>  $except
     */
    public static function currentItemIndex(array $items, array $except = []): int|string|null
    {
        foreach ($items as $index => $item) {
            if (empty($item['route'])) {
                continue;
            }

            if (in_array($item['key'] ?? null, $except, true)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (($item['active'] ?? false) === true) {
                return $index;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Key identifying the page being rendered. Uses the current navigation
     * item's key when the page is a navigation target, so the region marker and
     * the link that points at it share one key space; otherwise falls back to
     * the current route name.
     *
     * @param  array<array-key, array<string, mixed>>  $items
     */
    public static function forCurrentPage(array $items, ?string $routeName = null): string
    {
        $index = self::currentItemIndex($items);

        if ($index !== null) {
            return self::forItem($items[$index]);
        }

        return self::normalize((string) $routeName);
    }

    private static function normalize(string $raw): string
    {
        $slug = trim((string) preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9]+/', '-', mb_strtolower($raw)), '-');

        return $slug === '' ? 'page' : $slug;
    }
}
